_title: FRESH PDB census re-run, 2026-08-05 — second grading of TRG-E3-RECRUITER-STRUCTURE
_cost: $0 — CI fetch only, no GPU, no rental.
_why: The 2026-08-03 grading rests on a PDB census. A census is a perishable fact and re-running it is free, so it was RE-RUN rather than quoted. Identical query shape per accession, so the two are directly comparable. This run also answers two questions the 2026-08-03 census could not.
_integrity: Every field below is FETCHED, not recalled, and not copied from the 2026-08-03 file. Provenance: .github/workflows/fetch-literature.yml run 31000949990 on branch main, corpus research/manuscripts/lit-targets-e3-recruiter-recheck-2026-08-05.json, raw text on the literature-cache branch under literature/e3-recruiter-recheck-20260805/.
_relation_to_prior: research/modalities/e3-recruiter-pdb-recheck-2026-08-03.json is the first grading. This file does NOT supersede it — it CONFIRMS it on a fresh reading and adds the two direct answers below. Neither file's numbers changed.

fetch_provenance._204_reading: RCSB returns 204 No Content for a zero-result search. Every 204 below is therefore a READING OF ABSENCE, not an absent reading.

DCAF16._verdict: Same 3 entries, all ternary (DCAF16 + DDB1 + a bromodomain partner). n_clean_binary_entries = 0.

FEM1B._verdict: NOT one of the blocked three. Already had 7 partner-free liganded entries before either paper. Unchanged.

new_this_run_1_release_bounded_query._why: The 2026-08-03 census answered 'has anything landed?' by COMPARING COUNTS between runs. A count that matches could in principle hide one entry added and one withdrawn. This asks the question directly.
new_this_run_1_release_bounded_query.query: accession AND rcsb_accession_info.initial_release_date >= 2026-07-25 (the date of the downselect this row rests on)
new_this_run_1_release_bounded_query._reading: ZERO structures have been RELEASED for any of the four accessions since the assessment was made. Not inferred from a count comparison — asked and answered.

new_this_run_2_citation_doi_query._why: METHOD FIX. On 2026-08-03 the question 'did either paper deposit a structure' was attempted via rcsb_primary_citation.pdbx_database_id_PubMed and returned HTTP 400 — 'search is not enabled on [that] attribute' — so it was answered only INDIRECTLY, by noting the entry sets were unchanged and cited to other journals. The DOI attribute IS searchable.
new_this_run_2_citation_doi_query._reading: NEITHER PAPER IS THE PRIMARY CITATION OF ANY RELEASED PDB ENTRY. This is now a direct measurement rather than an inference, and it is the single cleanest statement of why the trigger is not satisfied.

blind_spot_quantified._what: A structure DEPOSITED but still ON HOLD is invisible to every query above. The 2026-08-03 file stated this; this run measures its size.
blind_spot_quantified._why_not_resolved: The holdings endpoint returns IDs only. Mapping 34,557 IDs to UniProt accessions needs one request each, which is not a $0 check and would still not see a title-suppressed entry. So the blind spot is real, bounded and NOT closed — which is why the trigger stays 'watching' rather than being retired.
blind_spot_quantified._what_would_close_it: The papers' own Data Availability statements, which are behind the paywall.

papers_still_paywalled._status: UNCHANGED from 2026-08-03 — still ABSTRACT ONLY for both.

literature_recheck._why: Has anything NEW appeared in the two days since the grading?
literature_recheck.result: No. Broad free-text EuropePMC searches on DCAF16 / DCAF15 / RNF114 crossed with structural terms return reviews and unrelated papers; no new structural report for any of the three blocked recruiters.
literature_recheck._note: These are DELIBERATELY broader than the trigger's own title-anchored queries — a wide net cast to check the narrow one is not missing something. It was not.

grade_2026_08_05.relation: CONFIRMS the 2026-08-03 verdict on an independent fresh reading. Not a new verdict — the same one, re-measured.
grade_2026_08_05.why: The row's criterion is a deposited partner-free liganded structure for RNF114, DCAF16 or DCAF15. Measured today: RNF114 0 entries, DCAF16 3 entries all ternary, DCAF15 9 entries unchanged; zero releases for any accession since 2026-07-25; and neither paper is the primary citation of any released entry. The DCAF16 paper's own abstract describes a template-assisted covalent glue — the warhead rides on the BRD4-targeting ligand and 'modifies DCAF16 at Cys58, promoting ternary complex formation' — which is the architecture the 0.3442 buried fraction already recorded, not a refutation of it.
grade_2026_08_05.evidence_level: DEFINITIVE on the PDB census (fetched twice, two days apart, by two independent runs). PROVISIONAL on the paper text — both remain paywalled and abstract-only, and an abstract cannot establish a buried-surface fraction or an exit vector.
